narrative.overview: A product launch for hardware Meiko designs and builds: dark cinematic hero and applications, clean premium capabilities and products, an industrial-intelligence solutions diagram.
keyCharacteristics: Real photographs and design-data renders carry the page; every illustration is labelled.
Hairline 1px rules and square corners; no glass or soft shadows.
Monospace only for codes, reference tags and captions.
One authored motion moment (hero plate unveil).
No technical grid is drawn over the page.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Signal marks action and signal flow only.

rules.name: The Matching Backdrop Rule
rules.body: Studio photos sit on a matching, feathered ground; scene photos fill their frame.

rules.name: The Two-Weight Rule
rules.body: Display and headline text pair a light line with a bold line.

rules.name: The Lit-Object Rule
rules.body: Shadows belong to physical objects (board, diagram nodes); containers stay flat.

dos: Do show real hardware large and lit, and label every image by type.
Do normalise studio photos and feather them; let scene photos fill the frame.
Do pair a light line with a bold line, with a real space between them.
Do keep signal orange for action and signal flow.
donts: Don't draw or generate a product shape.
Don't paste photos as visible rectangles on a mismatched ground.
Don't publish a number, customer or certification without a source.
